before: The layout of a populated TOC suppressed its standalone closing paragraph.
after: The authored closing line of a populated TOC stays in layout, with or without a wrapping content control, including its spacing before following content.
reason: The change retains the authored closing line in layout and protects its paragraph mark during selection formatting. The write guard also lets a section mark land on that line and exempts page setup and other package-level writes from the caret check; a new TOC is refused inside an existing field; these change which local edits are admitted, not the shape of any operation. Canonical nodes, operations, snapshots and serialization retain their existing shapes.
